properties.name: Andheri West Core
properties.methodNote: Approximate analysis polygon created for TreeScore satellite-derived green-cover analysis. Not an official administrative boundary.
properties.sourceNote: Boundary drawn using visible locality context, major roads, coastline, railway/metro corridors, lake/park edges and commonly understood neighbourhood extent. Held west of the Western Railway line; represents the western Andheri core (Seven/Four Bungalows, DN Nagar, Azad Nagar, station-side west) and NOT the full Andheri West real-estate footprint or deep Lokhandwala/Oshiwara.
properties.publicDisclaimer: Locality boundaries are TreeScore-defined analysis areas, not official administrative boundaries.

properties.name: Powai Lake + Urban Area
properties.methodNote: Approximate analysis polygon created for TreeScore satellite-derived green-cover analysis. Not an official administrative boundary.
properties.sourceNote: Tightened relative to v0.1 to focus on the Powai urban / lake-edge neighbourhood (Hiranandani area, lake-edge residential, JVLR-side urban fabric). Main Powai Lake water body excluded via inner ring. Deliberately excludes Vikhroli, Sanjay Gandhi National Park, Aarey and large institutional/forest green zones that inflated the v0.1 green-cover reading. Google Earth Engine water masking must still be applied as a backstop.

properties.name: Juhu
properties.methodNote: Approximate analysis polygon created for TreeScore satellite-derived green-cover analysis. Not an official administrative boundary.
properties.sourceNote: Conservative coastal polygon using the Arabian Sea beach as the western edge (tightened slightly eastward from v0.1 to keep dry sand/sea out of the land denominator) and the commonly understood Juhu residential/coastal neighbourhood. Avoids Vile Parle, Santacruz, Andheri West, Versova and airport land.
